_doc: GENERATED by tools/build-home-stats.mjs — do not hand-edit. Homepage snapshot source of truth.

definitions.subcategory_standards_in_force: Count of live standard pages on the register: content/standards/*.md with type: standard. Excludes index, finder, draft, scaffold, and standard-in-development.
definitions.carrying_firm_limit: In-force pages whose compiled claim surface is COMPLETE (tools/lib/claim-surface.mjs evaluateClaimSurface). Aggregate pages are COMPLETE only when every child record is COMPLETE. Incomplete chocolate-style rows are excluded.
definitions.firm_analyte_limits: Count of numeric metal×standard limit cells whose kind is gov, read_across, or form_split (gov_floor presentation). One cell per analyte per compiled record. TODO / monitored / subsumed-null / control / not-material are excluded.
definitions.certified_analyte_panel: Locked claim-surface panel size = CLAIM_TOTALS.length (Big-8 totals). Program Manual Part 2: eight limit analytes. Species are pathway reflexes, not extra panel seats. The retired homepage 10 was a miscount.
definitions.priority_metals: Locked Big-8 (Pb, tAs, Cd, tHg, Ni, Sn, Al, Cr) = CLAIM_TOTALS.length.
definitions.current_edition: Latest four-digit edition year from data/manuals/manifest.json (program edition SoT).
definitions.as_of: ISO date of generate (YYYY-MM-DD). The homepage omits a frozen 'As of' line because the snapshot is live-at-build.
definitions.live_dois: In-force pages whose cert_doi is a production DataCite DOI (not a sandbox/test prefix).
